name: Stormbringer: Thundershocker works natively (#1682)
contract: #1682: Thundershocker (300610) is a flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (23, i.e. effect index 2) modifier, EffectBasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = +30, class mask (0,0,2), which matches Eye of the Storm's own family-22 flags (0,0,2). The chain is 806307 -> periodic trigger 806455 -> trigger 807712, and 807712's own effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER (base 0); the modifier raises that amount from 0 to 30 on the root debuff itself, so 'while rooted by Eye of the Storm' is satisfied by construction. Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken applies it to any family-22 hit from the same caster (Unit.cpp), read here through spell_damage_taken on the rooted dummy (fixed base 1000 per apps/coa-gameplay-test/README.md, target identifies the attacker), giving 1000 -> 1300. The root debuff is snapshotted at application time, so Eye of the Storm is re-cast after learning the talent instead of re-reading a stale aura. High Voltage (570191, issue #2154) was proved separately and lives in stormbringer-lightning-chain-family-high-voltage.json; this scenario asserts #1682 only.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the fixture has enough mana for a 37% base mana cast
Let the periodic trigger apply the root
BASELINE: Eye of the Storm's root debuff is applied
BASELINE: the root's own damage-from-caster amount is 0 without Thundershocker
BASELINE: Forked Lightning's incoming-damage query is the metric's fixed 1000 against the rooted target
Keep the proven pacing between the two Eye of the Storm casts, which share the 1000-1500 ms global cooldown of StartRecoveryCategory 133
Let the periodic trigger re-apply the root with Thundershocker learned
DISCRIMINATING: Thundershocker raises the root's damage-from-caster amount to 30
DISCRIMINATING: Forked Lightning's incoming-damage query against the rooted target rises to 1300
